==Construction==

Construction instructions for the following solids are available: [[Platonic solid]]s,{{sfn|Wenninger|1971|pp=17–19}} [[Archimedean solid]]s,{{sfn|Wenninger|1971|pp=23–24,26,28,30}} [[Catalan solid|Achiral Catalan solids]],{{sfn|Wenninger|1983|pp=14–35}} [[Kepler–Poinsot polyhedron|Kepler–Poinsot solids]],{{sfn|Wenninger|1971|pp=38–40,63}} [[Uniform star polyhedron#Icosahedral symmetry|Achiral nonconvex uniform polyhedra]],{{sfn|Wenninger|1971|pp=106–117,123–131,135–143,147–158,161–170,200–203}} Chiral Archimedean and Catalan solids: [[Snub dodecahedron]]{{sfn|Wenninger|1971|p=32}} and [[Pentagonal hexecontahedron]],{{sfn|Wenninger|1983|p=29}} and [[Uniform star polyhedron#Icosahedral symmetry|Chiral nonconvex uniform polyhedra]].{{sfn|Wenninger|1971|pp=172–199}}
